## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, Prettier, tests)
- [ ] Added/updated tests in `test/e2e.mjs` for behaviour changes
- [ ] If `spec/` or `scripts/generate.mjs` changed: ran `npm run generate` and committed `src/generated/`
- [ ] Updated `README.md` for user-facing changes (env vars, tools, setup)
- [ ] Added an entry under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
